name: Al Damyati Restaurant Al Barsha
address: 456R+VMM - Al Barsha First - Al Barsha - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: A Timeless Taste of Tradition: Celebrating 50+ Years of Grills, Hummus, and Falafel

reviews.author: EH H
reviews.text: Very clean restaurant, and the lamb chops taste so good!!!!! Ordering 1kg for 2-3adults is enough. Hot breads are served unlimitedly, but hummus is served only one time.

reviews.author: Insha
reviews.text:
I visited Al Damyati and came away impressed by both the quality and generosity of the experience. From the moment we sat down, the table was quickly filled with complimentary hummus and fresh salad, which set the tone for what was to come.

The meal began with lentil soup, and it was exceptional. Rich, comforting, and full of depth, it easily stood out as one of the best I have had. It felt like a dish that had been made with care and tradition.

The highlight, however, was the lamb chops. Al Damyati is known for them, and it is clear why. They were cooked perfectly, tender, juicy, and packed with flavour. Easily among the best lamb chops I have tried in Dubai.

We also ordered the mixed grill, which did not disappoint. The meat was succulent, well seasoned, and cooked just right. Every bite felt satisfying, and the portion sizes were more than generous.

Overall, a reliable spot for hearty, flavourful food. You leave full, satisfied, and already thinking about your next visit.

reviews.author: Mohamed Ashraf
reviews.text:
The food at Al Damyati is super authentic and delicious literally everything you need from Egyptian cuisine is right here.
Special thanks to Mr. Ahmed for the amazing hospitality and great treatment. They really care about the small details and offer things you just don't see in other restaurants. High quality, warm atmosphere, and great service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Raif Shaikh
reviews.text:
This restaurant used to be my go to place for lamb chops and kabab when I was in my teen which is nearly more than 15 years ago and in the middle their taste had changed but today when we tried it it brought back memories of my childhood.

The lamb chops are toooo good and their kabab are still the same soft juicy and just melts in your mouth. Arayesh and falafel too. Will definitely be returning and thank you for bringing back the same taste.

reviews.author: Amaad
reviews.text: The kebabs here were so juicy and cooked perfectly. The lamb chops were tasty, juicy and charred. Exactly like how they should be. Very reasonable and will 100% be back.

reviews.author: Noorah Noorah
reviews.text: Good place to dine at a decent price; delicious and big serving food. Staff and owner are very accommodating. The best place to dine with friends and family at Al barsha:)

reviews.author: rashmi panoli
reviews.text:
Damayati is my favorite Egyptian restaurant and I visit regularly! Their falafel is honestly the best I’ve ever had – perfectly crispy on the outside and soft, flavorful inside. You can really taste the freshness and authentic spices.

The breads are also amazing – warm, soft, and the perfect match with the falafel and dips. Their complimentary soup is special.

If you love authentic Egyptian food, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended! 🇪🇬✨

reviews.author: Jacob Slopnicki
reviews.text: Habibi you must come here and try true Egyptian cuisine! Great hospitality, great food and great value for money. In addition to what we ordered we were offered complimentary free soups, hummus, salads and very nice warm glass of tea at the end. For the minus part the waiters could smile a bit more and the interior is very simple, almost cold. Food on the other hand is very reasonably priced and very tasty. Come here for food - you will not regret, Habibi! Baba ghanong and mutabale was my absolute favourite (smoked eggplant with garlic and tomatoes).

reviews.author: Arriz Panopio
reviews.text: Super love their chicken pulao! I gisit their establishment at least once a week and they never disappoint with their rice. I also like the lentil soup and the tea that they give customers. Everyone is usually nice and warm and welcoming whenever I visit - even if I usually just go for take out.

reviews.author: András Łukasz Chabin
reviews.text:
I have already been to Al Damyati express at the airport and always loved their lamb chops, which I believe is the best I have ever tried. I was super happy when I realized that they opened a new place in Barsha.

The food and the prices are the same as in the other locations, but the restaurant is new and much nicer than the express one. You can choose between table sitting or carpets in a box. The waiter was super nice and helpful. Can't wait to go back and try out their mixed grill options.

Lentil soup, hummus and salad are included, we paid 90-100 AED for the lamp chops, aubergine based food and falafel (including the tip).

I would definitely recommend
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you very much for your lovely words and your feedback.we can't wait to see you soon again . we are So proud hearing this lovely words 🙏

reviews.author: Amr Heikal
reviews.text:
Let me tell you something clearly. You can only eat the best lamb chops in Dubai at Al Damyati. Period.  I’ve been a loyal fan since 2010 and their new Al Barsha branch just made life easier for me. It’s closer to home, way more polished than the Karama one, and still keeps the same great food and friendly prices.

Finding it on Google was a nightmare though. The search kept showing the two other branches but not this one. Turns out this place used to be Afghan Pallow Palace. Same spot, totally different vibe now. This new branch blows the Karama location out of the water. Everything looks so much nicer. The furniture, the utensils, even got a private dining room if you want it. You can sit on the floor in some dedicated corner areas too. Still the same incredible food but packaged way better. An updated Al Damyati vibe and a few Afghan dishes have been added to the menu like Bukhari rice and fresh Afghani bread. Good thing, because both are amazing.

We were a party of 4. Right after we sat, the feast began.They started us with complimentary lentil soup that scored a solid 20/10 in my book. Reminded me of my grandmother's soup back in the cold winters of Alexandria. I could honestly come back just for this soup. Then came fresh falafel, hummus, tahini, garlic sauce, spicy green chili sauce, and a nice side salad. What a spread, all complimentary, all tasty. We ordered 2 kilos of their signature lamb chops, 200 AED per kilo. That’s my go-to, and it never disappoints. Always juicy, always full of flavor. We added Egyptian kofta for 60 AED (9/10), one Arayess with minced meat (10/10), Alexandrian liver (8/10), and a plate of fried eggplant that wasn’t even on the menu, but they still made it for me (10/10). One of the staff offered us a complimentary Bukhari rice, since   we're regulars at Karama (normally 15 AED). That rice was cooked the Afghani way with carrots and raisins. Beautiful texture, perfect balance of sweet and savory (10/10). When we ordered tea we were surprised that it was not included in the bill; it was also offered to us as complimentary. I can’t thank enough the team of Al Damyati for their generosity and kindness.

Before leaving as usual, I grabbed my usual Egyptian foul to go. I freeze these boxes at home and pull one out whenever I need comfort food, an easy meal and it never fails me.

The service here is top-notch. The team went above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed everything. They are super friendly and welcoming. Best part? You can eat at Al Damyati for 15 AED or splurge for 200 AED. Sandwiches run 5 to 8 AED. Vegetarian dishes 10 to 40 AED. Grill items 20 to 50 AED.

Having my favorite comfort spot so much closer to home now makes me really happy. I'll definitely be coming here way more often. Al Damyati is deffintely a  Dubai icon and I highly highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Virgiele Michelle Correos
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Riyah Altejos

I never thought that the price for their food was so cheap it looked expensive, but the deal was perfect since the ambiance of their restaurant is so classy inside and out. You must try it and especially the "KUNAFA" cream for dessert. ❤️

reviews.author: Ehlyne Beleno
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience! Muhammad Asher provided great service — very friendly, attentive, and professional. The food was excellent, full of flavor and beautifully presented. Highly recommend this restaurant!

reviews.text: We visited this restaurant in March 2024. We received a very friendly welcome and got to know the wonderful flavors of Afghan cuisine. The portions are so huge that we couldn't even eat all the food. The prices are very reasonable and the overall atmosphere of the beautiful restaurant will make a wonderful impression on you. I'm really looking forward to take my friends here in March again.

reviews.author: Thandi D.
reviews.text: usually come at a quieter time. however, the food, service and atmosphere is fantastic! definitely worth the messiness of Al Barsha to get here.

reviews.author: Bee
reviews.text: Damyati has been a childhood favorite.  No matter how many new places come up, no one beats it. They have the best kebabs period.

reviews.author: Asif Pesnani
reviews.text:
Afghan Pallow is conveniently situated in Barsha, near the Novotel hotel. Visiting on a weekday night meant ample parking, although Barsha can sometimes pose a challenge in that regard.

Upon entering, we found the restaurant to be spacious and well-lit. Our group was seated at a generously sized table tucked away in a corner, almost providing a sense of private dining. Acting on a friend's recommendation, we eagerly sampled the offerings, and we were not disappointed:

Soup: 5/5 - Truly remarkable; a delightful surprise.
Lassi: 3.5/5 - Adequate, though I've had better elsewhere.
Special Chicken Karahi: 4/5 - As a fervent enthusiast of Mutton Karahi, this commendation speaks volumes. While enjoyable, I've experienced superior versions elsewhere.
Lamb Chops: 4/5 - Tasty, though not the absolute best I've tasted.
Other Kebabs: 4/5 - Decently satisfying.

In terms of value for money, we found it to be quite fair, earning a rating of 4/5.

Overall, I would gladly revisit Afghan Pallow, perhaps exploring different items on the menu. Our departure left us content, with plans already in motion for a return visit.

reviews.author: Live the life
reviews.text:
Lamb chops at its best. Kebabs tastes good with Bread with hummus and tahini .
Kunafa could have served hot.

reviews.author: Adeel Shams
reviews.text: We received an invitation for dinner at this recently opened Afghan restaurant. The restaurant boasts impressive decor and big seating area, accompanied by excellent service. Ordered Peshawari Kadai and a Mix Platter with Kabuli pulow from their menu, we found the flavors to be delightful. The convenience of restaurant parking, a rarity in this area, was a definite plus. Highly recommended for families

reviews.author: Rashid Alawadi (randomthings)
reviews.text: I love to visit this place for lamb chops and arayes as they have good quality food with affordable prices.

reviews.author: Ree A
reviews.text: I’ve been a regular at their Karama branch for the past 4 years, and I’m so glad they’ve finally opened in Al Barsha! The lamb chops are absolutely out of this world — tender, flavorful, and perfectly grilled. The grilled boneless chicken and falafel are also fantastic. What makes the experience even better is that they serve complimentary falafel, hummus, tahini, pickled vegetables, and salad-such a generous touch. This new branch also features some amazing additions like Afghani mutton pulao, lentil soup, and their house-baked bread — all must-tries. Highly recommended!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your feedback and this wonderful words you kept it's really an honour to us and we're so glad with every time we get the chance to serve you again

reviews.author: Vivian Fay Atienza
reviews.text: Very cool ambiance. They have big serving of food and worth it for the price. We ordered kebab and afghan pulao and they gave us complementary falafel and soup.Their staff Mohammad is very kind and accommodating. Good experience.
reviews.owner_reply: We're so happy with this lovely feedback and so grateful for taking your time to send us this word's and we'd love to see you soon so can serve you with a better way than it was

reviews.author: Asad Iqbal
reviews.text:
Lunch Order Review - Mutton Dish

We recently ordered lunch for our office from Afghan Pallow Place Resturant and opted for their mutton dish. While the flavour was acceptable, the food arrived cold, which was disappointing. Furthermore, the portion size was inadequate considering the prices.

Rating: 2.5/5

Areas for Improvement:

1. Ensure timely delivery and maintain food temperature.
2. Reassess portion sizes to provide better value for money.

reviews.author: Nabeel Hood

reviews.author: Murad Hamed

I rate this restaurant 5/5 , i am definitely going again
